form.div: Questions are added to the end of the selected course content. Existing questions are kept. Supported types: single choice, multiple choice, true/false, short answer, essay, and listening.

div.p: Download the Excel template, fill in one question per row, and keep the original column headers unchanged. Save the file as .xlsx. The importer reads the first worksheet; blank rows are ignored. Questions will be attached to the video, audio, document, or quiz slide currently open.

ul.li: single_choice: fill at least two answer options; mark exactly one Correct cell as TRUE, and the others as FALSE.
multiple_choice: fill at least two options; mark one or more correct options TRUE and at least one incorrect option FALSE.
true_false: use the options True and False; mark exactly one as correct.
short_answer: fill Accepted Answers. Separate acceptable alternatives with |, for example xie xie|谢谢.
essay: fill Grading Rubric with the points the teacher should assess.

listening: choose choice or short_answer in Listening Answer Type and fill the corresponding answer columns. Excel does not embed the audio file: open the imported question, set its type to Listening, upload an MP3/WAV/OGG/WebM/M4A file in Audio File, and save. The student audio player appears above the answer choices.

div.p: Question is required. Question Type uses one of the values above. Weight must be greater than zero (blank defaults to 1). Required and Allow Partial Score accept TRUE or FALSE. For choice questions, the template provides four answer slots; unused slots can stay blank. Answer feedback/comment cells are optional.

Imported questions are appended after existing questions; importing does not replace or delete them. Export Questions downloads the current questions in the same editable format. Audio files are not embedded in Excel: upload the audio on each Listening question after import.
